findings: No mandatory multi-minute sleep explains this chain. The 750 ms dispatcher poll alone cannot explain 130-152 seconds.

REH14's 129.574/152.244 seconds end at card.createdAt, before PDF rendering/publication/verification. Verified target stamps are 150.035/152.487 seconds after confirmation. Their completions are only 2.452 seconds apart.
The 22.670 s gap between card creation stamps contains 20.461 s of the cited card's render/publication/read/verification tail, not another 22-second card build.

The run already calls all target stages directly. Act 1 has a CSV packet then a locally rendered card PDF: no packet-pdf job, wait-for-job loop or awaited runtime teacher/gateway call. Studio already refetches on target events.
